name: Mononoke Chigiri
source: After one thousand years, the great yokai “Bake neko,” who was sealed away by the protagonist’s ancestor Abe no Seimei, begins the process of resurfacing in the world once again. The protagonist, an onmyoji, confronts the Great Yokai alongside the yokai that appear before her…
translation: 一千年后，被主角的祖先安倍晴明封印的大妖怪“化猫”，再次开始了在世界上重新出现的过程。主角，阴阳师，与出现在她面前的妖怪一起对抗大妖怪……
